CustomField.description:
The customer is registered for with the Qantas Business Rewards loyalty program (previously Aquire). This calculates eligibility for airline discounts
STME-2670 Changes on Eligibility all Amex customers are GST registered and will have an eligible entity type, so therefore we do not need to check this
Changes on Dec 28.12.2016 --> Updated the Dates to (2016,12,12) for simulating the test Records End to End.Need to be changed to (2017,2,1) once testing done
CustomField.formula: IF ( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Aquire_Override__c,'Y')), IF ( Aquire_System__c = true, IF ( ISPICKVAL(Agency__c, 'N'), IF ( ISPICKVAL(Dealing_Flag__c, 'N'), IF ( Aquire_Enrollment_Date_System__c >= DATE(2017,02,01) && AMEX__c != true , IF ( ISPICKVAL(GST_Registered__c, 'N'), IF ( Valid_Entity_Type__c = 'N', 'N', 'Y'), 'Y'), 'Y'), 'N'), 'N'), 'N'), 'N')
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Determines eligibility for airline discounts based on Override, QBR Registration, Travel Agency, SME Deal, previous Aquire Membership, GST Registration and Entity Type
CustomField.label: Airline Eligibility
